title: Fixed Raised Head and Rail Transport Couch
description: One original complete fixed raised-head transport-couch visual prop. Four equal small tires in full open forks support a narrow open lower chassis. Two independent layered crossed supports carry a long upper platform with a separate fixed inclined head panel and cushion. Two raised open tubular side barriers with full intermediate stanchions, a separate head-end push handle and distinct fixed pivot exteriors complete the whole medical transport furniture silhouette. Newly authored complete geometry, not the old bed with wheels or a renamed cargo lift. One prop zero scenes, three opaque materials. Static unoccupied artistic exterior only: no actual patient transport, lifting, folding, adjustment, wheel steering, brake action, force, load, stability, ergonomics, hygiene, clinical suitability, certification or medical-device safety claim. No rigging animation or interaction is supplied.
